claims: Tom Cruise is the primary star of Top Gun (1986).
Tom Cruise plays LT/Capt. Pete "Maverick" Mitchell.
Val Kilmer plays Iceman in Top Gun (1986).
Kelly McGillis plays Charlie in Top Gun (1986).
Anthony Edwards plays Goose in Top Gun (1986).
Tom Skerritt plays Viper in Top Gun (1986).
Iceman is Maverick's primary rival turned wingman.
Charlie is Maverick's love interest in Top Gun (1986).
Viper is a Top Gun instructor.
